info.title: XUI platform and node API
info.description: Independent subscription platform with verified payment adapters and read-only statement discrepancy reports. Adds source-bound immutable native fee/channel amount observations with exact five-decimal yuan strings and explicit reference-CSV comparisons. Different raw sources sharing canonical gross facts retain separate financial observations; missing historical fields remain unavailable until explicit same-file reimport. No fee-rate/net-amount guessing, bank settlement confirmation, payment/refund execution or entitlement change. Daily downloads remain opt-in; full fund-flow/balance reconciliation and real merchant acceptance remain pending.

post.description: Node Bearer identity only, no browser Origin. Same node/batch ID and canonical content returns the same acknowledgement without charging again. Changed content or reuse of node/core/sequence returns 409. Unissued historical ownership returns 403. All items, raw up+down byte debits and evidence commit in one transaction; overage is recorded rather than clamped. Historical expired periods are accepted only within issued authorization history, with 30 seconds of clock/measurement tolerance. Revoked identities return 401. Agent must verify acknowledged batch ID and digest before deleting its local outbox entry.

post.description: For Alipay and WeChat, verifies signed query responses and exact payment ID/amount/currency before atomic fulfillment. Classic Epay api.php has no authenticated response contract; this adapter does not call it or settle from unsigned JSON and returns502 until a valid signed notify is processed. Pending verified results preserve the intent. Verified email required in production; separate shared peer/user sync limit10/5 per minute. Already paid intents return their stored state. This is also the proof boundary used by durable background reconciliation. A valid late paid result may fulfill an expired order; local expiry never substitutes for gateway closure.

Native upload works with bill downloads disabled. v0.14 attaches source-bound exact five-decimal fee/channel amount observations atomically with successful native import/download completion; no raw-file persistence. Unknown Alipay cells remain null. WeChat fee/channel summary mismatches create separate warnings without changing canonical gross reports. Existing legacy sources are not guessed/backfilled; explicit same-file native reimport may add the first immutable observation.

post.summary: Staff: queue or resume an on-demand merchant bill download
post.description: Admin/finance only; production requires verified email. Rejects query parameters and unknown request fields. No payment, refund, order, entitlement or funds-action state is changed. Requires explicit BILL_DOWNLOADS_ENABLED=true and configured optional BillProvider capability (Alipay/WeChat only, no common Epay protocol). Request performs no outboundI/O. Rate5 per direct peer and5 per user per minute for bill-download. One job per provider/kind/date/merchant fingerprint; repeats of active/succeeded jobs reuse it and manual_required may reset under fresh current actor/security version. Background worker uses60s token lease,25s operation,5s database finish, fresh signed metadata URL per retry, no externalI/O under financial locks. Gateway/verification/storage/not-ready errors retry30..1800s,8failures or7days thenmanual; parse/profile, unsupported and actor/merchant change become manual immediately. Signed metadata and strict HTTPS origin/path/no redirect constrain downloads. WeChat GZIP original uncompressed bytes must match signed SHA1; Alipay requests secure=true and verifies signed URL but classic results remain partial. Daily schedules may generate the same job identity; an explicit retry of manual_required detaches obsolete schedule authorization. Invalid automatic authorization becomes schedule_changed/manual_required. No raw files or URLs are persisted. Success/import/report/source/job completion commit atomically. v0.14 attaches source-bound exact five-decimal fee/channel amount observations atomically with successful native import/download completion; no raw-file persistence. Unknown Alipay cells remain null. WeChat fee/channel summary mismatches create separate warnings without changing canonical gross reports. Existing legacy sources are not guessed/backfilled; explicit same-file native reimport may add the first immutable observation.

put.summary: Staff: configure or disable a daily merchant bill schedule
put.description: Admin/finance only; production requires verified email. Strict single JSON object, no query, current revisionCAS, rate5 per direct peer and5 per user per minute for bill-schedule. Enabling requires BILL_DOWNLOADS_ENABLED=true and configured Alipay/WeChat BillProvider; disabling remains allowed with the gate off or provider absent. Saves authorization without outboundI/O. New/re-enabled plans and explicitly reauthorized new merchant identities start with yesterday in Shanghai; active same-merchant edits preserve cursor. Business dateD is dueD+1 at run_at. Recovery queues only the last7 completed Shanghai days. Stable identity inserts missing jobs, never restarts manual_required or takes over existing on-demand jobs; cursor, job and audit commit atomically. Role/security-version or merchant changes pause the plan. Disable/re-enable or authority change invalidates unfinished automatic jobs; completion rechecks live authorization. Same-authority time-only edits retain authorization. Saving is not download/import success; no funds or entitlement changes.

post.description: Admin/finance only; production requires verified email. Rejects all query parameters. Source/report must belong to the complete nested parent chain. Independent of PAYMENT_ACTIONS_ENABLED and BILL_DOWNLOADS_ENABLED. No merchant network request, payment/refund/order/action/entitlement mutation or bank settlement assertion. Requires strict single JSON{csv},2MiB body/1MiB UTF8 CSV/2000 rows, explicit signed five-decimal yuan expectations; no fee-rate or net formula. Rate5 per direct peer and5 per user per minute for financial-reconcile. Requires a source financial snapshot, otherwise409. Current session security version is checked under actor lock. Reference digest canonicalizes identity ordering and decimal spellings; same source+digest reuses its immutable report, changed content creates a new revision. Source/reference union includes missing references as unassessed, missing observations or unknown/mismatched amounts as differences; never treats absent expectations as matched. Snapshot/report/audit transaction failures leave no partial evidence.

csv.description: Normalized UTF-8 CSV v1, byte limit1MiB and2000 data rows. Exact ordered header: payment_id,transaction_id,refund_id,provider_refund_id,amount_minor,currency,occurred_at. Optional BOM andCRLF allowed; blank lines, invalidUTF8, controls, duplicates, malformed CSV, unknown columns, fractional/overflow/zero amounts, nonCNY, or timestamps outside selected Shanghai day reject the entire batch. amount_minor input is positive canonical integer cents; occurred_at isRFC3339 with an explicit offset. Payment rows require both original IDs and empty refund fields; refund rows require all4IDs. All identifiers follow ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,127}$. Original provider CSV is not accepted directly. Fractional seconds allow at most9digits. Validate the original instant against day boundaries, then normalize UTC and truncate to microseconds before hashing/persistence to match PostgreSQL precision.

Concurrent identical imports may safely return retryable409; dedup guarantees no duplicate records, not that every concurrent caller receives200.
